note: The AlgoLift strategy node's own formula on the cases TA-Lib was compared on (talib/stoch.json, STOCH). It differs from TA-Lib by a convention, so these numbers are its own: A window whose highest high equals its lowest low (no range) has no %K, so the averages over it have none either; TA-Lib writes 0 there. Publishes percent_k from its own first bar; TA-Lib publishes slow %K only from %D's first bar. The Slow type always slows %K by 3 bars, Full slows it by k_slow_period, and Fast is TA-Lib's STOCHF (no slowing). Defaults to 14, 3 and 3 (TA-Lib: 5, 3 and 3). Adds percent_j (3 times %K less 2 times %D), raw_k (the unslowed %K) and slope, which TA-Lib does not compute.
